# Retries and rate limits

Every write the provider makes carries an `Idempotency-Key`, generated per
operation and reused when the provider retries it, so a retried apply step
never creates a resource twice.

A `429` or `503` is retried with backoff, waiting for the `Retry-After` the
platform names, up to 60 seconds. A longer wait fails the operation with the
platform's message.

Writes are limited to 60 per minute per credential. A large plan can reach that
limit, and the retries absorb it.

The synchronous writes (`nemau_keypair`, `nemau_load_balancer_certificate`,
`nemau_container_credential`) carry no key and are not retried after a `429`
or a `5xx`. Run `terraform apply` again.
